thread:
maya: Heads-up: access-lint-bot flagged a project-admin binding with no clear owner on analytics-prod. Need rapid triage and KMS check. @oncall pls ack. :eyes:

oncall: Acked. Share the binding snippet and any audit link.

maya: Snapshot: `roles/editor` + `roles/owner` -> `serviceAccount:svc-analytics-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on `projects/analytics-prod`. Audit event 2026-03-19T11:02Z. Raw event: https://logs.internal/reports/513210-evidence

access-lint-bot: auto-note: detected ownerless-admin pattern. Created evidence package: https://s3.internal/audit/analytics-svc-ingest-513210.csv

jamal: KMS question: does this SA have cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter or keyAdmin on any customer or internal keys? If so we must plan rotation.

sasha: Bundle shows `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on keyRing `analytics-keys/ck-ingest` and a few short-lived decrypts in the last week. Uploads in bundle.

oli: If owner can't be found in 24h we should: (1) apply emergency demotion to custom role (remove Owner), (2) rotate affected keys and update dependent services, (3) run a targeted least-privilege audit across analytics-prod SAs.

maya: Evidence hygiene: check for PR/ticket or automation actor. If none, mark undocumented and create forensic ticket.

oncall: I'll create INC-2026-5132 and coordinate the ACL window (12-36h). I'll also page infra automation owners.

jamal: Commands used to capture state:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy analytics-prod --format=json > analytics-iam-513210.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner")' analytics-iam-513210.json
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ck-ingest --location=global --keyring=analytics-keys --project=analytics-prod
```

sasha: Assignments: Jamal  lead KMS rotate plan (48h). Oli  enumerate cronjobs and downstream deps (24h). Maya  consolidate evidence and flag undocumented change (12h). Oncall  create incident and apply emergency ACL if no owner (12-36h).

oli: Small mitigation note: prefer removing Owner binding explicitly rather than deleting SA to avoid breaking service tokens. Document exact gcloud commands used when applying ACL.

maya: Thanks. This thread is canonical for coordination on this orphaned entitlement. :thumbsup:
